handle: Blessed with every spiritual blessing, already, in Christ.
text: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who hath blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ:

handle: Chosen before the world began, to be holy and blameless in love.
text: According as he hath chosen us in him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without blame before him in love:

handle: Destined for adoption as his child, by his pleasure and will.
text: Having predestinated us unto the adoption of children by Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his will,

handle: Accepted in the Beloved; this is the praise of his grace.
text: To the praise of the glory of his grace, wherein he hath made us accepted in the beloved.

handle: Redeemed and forgiven, according to the riches of his grace.
text: In whom we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, according to the riches of his grace;

handle: Grace lavished on you; he made his will known to you.
text: Wherein he hath abounded toward us in all wisdom and prudence; Having made known unto us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he hath purposed in himself:

handle: You have an inheritance; he works all things by his purpose.
text: In whom also we have obtained an inheritance, being predestinated according to the purpose of him who worketh all things after the counsel of his own will:

handle: Sealed with the Holy Spirit, the guarantee of what is coming.
text: In whom ye also trusted, after that ye heard the word of truth, the gospel of your salvation: in whom also after that ye believed, ye were sealed with that holy Spirit of promise, Which is the earnest of our inheritance until the redemption of the purchased possession, unto the praise of his glory.

handle: Paul gives thanks, unceasingly, for people's faith and love for all the saints.
text: Wherefore I also, after I heard of your faith in the Lord Jesus, and love unto all the saints, Cease not to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers;

handle: Prayer that the eyes of your heart be enlightened to know your hope, inheritance and his power.
text: That the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give unto you the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him: The eyes of your understanding being enlightened; that ye may know what is the hope of his calling, and what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints, And what is the exceeding greatness of his power to us-ward who believe, according to the working of his mighty power,

handle: Christ is head over all things for the sake of the church.
text: And hath put all things under his feet, and gave him to be the head over all things to the church, Which is his body, the fulness of him that filleth all in all.

handle: Honest memory: you were dead, following the world and your desires.
text: And you hath he quickened, who were dead in trespasses and sins; Wherein in time past ye walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit that now worketh in the children of disobedience: Among whom also we all had our conversation in times past in the lusts of our flesh, fulfilling the desires of the flesh and of the mind; and were by nature the children of wrath, even as others.

handle: But God, rich in mercy and great love, made you alive with Christ.
text: But God, who is rich in mercy, for his great love wherewith he loved us, Even when we were dead in sins, hath quickened us together with Christ, (by grace ye are saved;)

handle: Raised with Christ and seated with him in the heavenly places.
text: And hath raised us up together, and made us sit together in heavenly places in Christ Jesus:

handle: He will show the immeasurable riches of his grace in his kindness to you.
text: That in the ages to come he might shew the exceeding riches of his grace in his kindness toward us through Christ Jesus.

handle: Saved by grace through faith; a gift, not your achievement.
text: For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God: Not of works, lest any man should boast.

handle: His workmanship, created for good works prepared beforehand for you to walk in.
text: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them.

handle: Remember what you were: far off, without hope, without God.
text: Wherefore remember, that ye being in time past Gentiles in the flesh, who are called Uncircumcision by that which is called the Circumcision in the flesh made by hands; That at that time ye were without Christ, being aliens from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of promise, having no hope, and without God in the world:

handle: Brought near by the blood of Christ.
text: But now in Christ Jesus ye who sometimes were far off are made nigh by the blood of Christ.

handle: He himself is our peace; he broke down the dividing wall and made one new people.
text: For he is our peace, who hath made both one, and hath broken down the middle wall of partition between us; Having abolished in his flesh the enmity, even the law of commandments contained in ordinances; for to make in himself of twain one new man, so making peace; And that he might reconcile both unto God in one body by the cross, having slain the enmity thereby:

handle: Peace preached to near and far; access to the Father by one Spirit.
text: And came and preached peace to you which were afar off, and to them that were nigh. For through him we both have access by one Spirit unto the Father.

handle: No longer strangers or foreigners; fellow citizens and members of God's household.
text: Now therefore ye are no more strangers and foreigners, but fellowcitizens with the saints, and of the household of God;

handle: Built on the apostles and prophets, with Christ as cornerstone, into a dwelling for God.
text: And are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone; In whom all the building fitly framed together groweth unto an holy temple in the Lord: In whom ye also are builded together for an habitation of God through the Spirit.

handle: Fellow heirs, members of one body, sharers in the promise.
text: That the Gentiles should be fellowheirs, and of the same body, and partakers of his promise in Christ by the gospel:

handle: Even the least of the saints is given grace.
text: Unto me, who am less than the least of all saints, is this grace given, that I should preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ;

handle: God's wisdom is shown through the church, by his eternal purpose.
text: To the intent that now unto the principalities and powers in heavenly places might be known by the church the manifold wisdom of God, According to the eternal purpose which he purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord:

handle: Boldness and confident access to God through faith in Christ.
text: In whom we have boldness and access with confidence by the faith of him.

handle: Every family is named from the Father.
text: For this cause I bow my knees unto the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, Of whom the whole family in heaven and earth is named,

handle: Strengthened with power in your inner being by his Spirit.
text: That he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, to be strengthened with might by his Spirit in the inner man;

handle: Christ dwelling in your heart by faith; rooted and grounded in love.
text: That Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith; that ye, being rooted and grounded in love,

handle: Grasp how wide, long, high and deep Christ's love is; be filled with God's fullness.
text: May be able to comprehend with all saints what is the breadth, and length, and depth, and height; And to know the love of Christ, which passeth knowledge, that ye might be filled with all the fulness of God.

handle: He is able to do far more than all we ask or think.
text: Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us, Unto him be glory in the church by Christ Jesus throughout all ages, world without end. Amen.

handle: Walk in a manner worthy of the calling you received.
text: I therefore, the prisoner of the Lord, beseech you that ye walk worthy of the vocation wherewith ye are called,

handle: Humility, gentleness, patience, bearing with one another in love.
text: With all lowliness and meekness, with longsuffering, forbearing one another in love;

handle: Be eager to keep the Spirit's unity in the bond of peace.
text: Endeavouring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.

handle: One body, one Spirit, one hope, one Lord, one faith, one baptism, one God and Father.
text: There is one body, and one Spirit, even as ye are called in one hope of your calling; One Lord, one faith, one baptism, One God and Father of all, who is above all, and through all, and in you all.

handle: Grace is given to each of you by Christ's measure.
text: But unto every one of us is given grace according to the measure of the gift of Christ.

handle: Gifted people exist to equip everyone for the work of service.
text: And he gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers; For the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for the edifying of the body of Christ:

handle: Aim at unity, maturity and the fullness of Christ.
text: Till we all come in the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, unto a perfect man, unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ:

handle: Do not be a child tossed by every wind of teaching and cunning scheme.
text: That we henceforth be no more children, tossed to and fro, and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the sleight of men, and cunning craftiness, whereby they lie in wait to deceive;

handle: Speak the truth in love and grow up into Christ in every way.
text: But speaking the truth in love, may grow up into him in all things, which is the head, even Christ:

handle: The whole body grows as each part works, building itself up in love.
text: From whom the whole body fitly joined together and compacted by that which every joint supplieth, according to the effectual working in the measure of every part, maketh increase of the body unto the edifying of itself in love.

handle: Do not think as others do: futile minds, darkened understanding, hardened hearts.
text: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that ye henceforth walk not as other Gentiles walk, in the vanity of their mind, Having the understanding darkened, being alienated from the life of God through the ignorance that is in them, because of the blindness of their heart: Who being past feeling have given themselves over unto lasciviousness, to work all uncleanness with greediness.

handle: That is not how you learned Christ; the truth is in Jesus.
text: But ye have not so learned Christ; If so be that ye have heard him, and have been taught by him, as the truth is in Jesus:

handle: Put off the old self, corrupted by deceitful desires.
text: That ye put off concerning the former conversation the old man, which is corrupt according to the deceitful lusts;

handle: Be renewed in the spirit of your mind.
text: And be renewed in the spirit of your mind;

handle: Put on the new self, made like God in true righteousness and holiness.
text: And that ye put on the new man, which after God is created in righteousness and true holiness.

handle: Put away falsehood and speak truth, for we are members of one another.
text: Wherefore putting away lying, speak every man truth with his neighbour: for we are members one of another.

handle: Be angry without sinning; do not let the sun set on it or give the devil a foothold.
text: Be ye angry, and sin not: let not the sun go down upon your wrath: Neither give place to the devil.

handle: Work honestly so you have something to share with those in need.
text: Let him that stole steal no more: but rather let him labour, working with his hands the thing which is good, that he may have to give to him that needeth.

handle: Let no corrupting talk out; only what builds up and gives grace to those who hear.
text: Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace unto the hearers.

handle: Do not grieve the Holy Spirit, who sealed you.
text: And grieve not the holy Spirit of God, whereby ye are sealed unto the day of redemption.

handle: Put away bitterness, rage, anger, shouting, slander and malice.
text: Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamour, and evil speaking, be put away from you, with all malice:

handle: Be kind, tender-hearted and forgiving, as God in Christ forgave you.
text: And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ’s sake hath forgiven you.

handle: Imitate God, as beloved children.
text: Be ye therefore followers of God, as dear children;

handle: Walk in love as Christ loved you and gave himself for you.
text: And walk in love, as Christ also hath loved us, and hath given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweetsmelling savour.

handle: Replace crude talk and impurity with thanksgiving.
text: But fornication, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not be once named among you, as becometh saints; Neither filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not convenient: but rather giving of thanks.

handle: Do not be deceived by empty words; do not partner with the disobedient.
text: For this ye know, that no whoremonger, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, hath any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God. Let no man deceive you with vain words: for because of these things cometh the wrath of God upon the children of disobedience. Be not ye therefore partakers with them.

handle: You were darkness, now you are light in the Lord; walk as children of light.
text: For ye were sometimes darkness, but now are ye light in the Lord: walk as children of light:

handle: Light's fruit is all that is good, right and true.
text: (For the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth;)

handle: Test what pleases the Lord.
text: Proving what is acceptable unto the Lord.

handle: Do not join in the fruitless works of darkness; expose them.
text: And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove them.

handle: Wake up, sleeper; Christ will shine on you.
text: Wherefore he saith, Awake thou that sleepest, and arise from the dead, and Christ shall give thee light.

handle: Walk carefully, as wise people, making the most of your time.
text: See then that ye walk circumspectly, not as fools, but as wise, Redeeming the time, because the days are evil.

handle: Do not be foolish; understand what the Lord's will is.
text: Wherefore be ye not unwise, but understanding what the will of the Lord is.

handle: Be filled with the Spirit.
text: And be not drunk with wine, wherein is excess; but be filled with the Spirit;

handle: Speak to one another in songs, and give thanks always.
text: Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord; Giving thanks always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ;

handle: Submit to one another out of reverence for Christ.
text: Submitting yourselves one to another in the fear of God.

handle: Wives: respectful submission, as to the Lord.
text: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord. For the husband is the head of the wife, even as Christ is the head of the church: and he is the saviour of the body. Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing.

handle: Husbands: love your wife as Christ loved the church and gave himself up for her.
text: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it; That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word, That he might present it to himself a glorious church, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish.

handle: Husbands: care for her as you do your own body, nourishing and cherishing.
text: So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies. He that loveth his wife loveth himself. For no man ever yet hated his own flesh; but nourisheth and cherisheth it, even as the Lord the church: For we are members of his body, of his flesh, and of his bones.

handle: One flesh; husband loves, wife respects.
text: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall be joined unto his wife, and they two shall be one flesh. This is a great mystery: but I speak concerning Christ and the church. Nevertheless let every one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself; and the wife see that she reverence her husband.

handle: Children: honor your father and mother.
text: Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right. Honour thy father and mother; (which is the first commandment with promise;) That it may be well with thee, and thou mayest live long on the earth.

handle: Fathers: do not provoke your children; raise them in the Lord's training and instruction.
text: And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.

handle: Work wholeheartedly, as for the Lord and not people; he repays good done.
text: Servants, be obedient to them that are your masters according to the flesh, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as unto Christ; Not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but as the servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart; With good will doing service, as to the Lord, and not to men: Knowing that whatsoever good thing any man doeth, the same shall he receive of the Lord, whether he be bond or free.

handle: Masters: do the same, drop the threats; God shows no partiality.
text: And, ye masters, do the same things unto them, forbearing threatening: knowing that your Master also is in heaven; neither is there respect of persons with him.

handle: Be strong in the Lord and in his mighty power, not your own.
text: Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.

handle: Put on the whole armor of God to stand against the devil's schemes.
text: Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.

handle: Your fight is not against people but against spiritual powers.
text: For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.

handle: Take the full armor so that you can stand firm on the evil day.
text: Wherefore take unto you the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.

handle: Belt of truth, breastplate of righteousness.
text: Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness;

handle: Feet ready with the gospel of peace.
text: And your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace;

handle: Shield of faith to put out the flaming arrows of the evil one.
text: Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.

handle: Helmet of salvation, sword of the Spirit which is God's word.
text: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God:

handle: Pray in the Spirit on all occasions, alert, for all the saints.
text: Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints;

handle: Ask others to pray that you speak boldly.
text: And for me, that utterance may be given unto me, that I may open my mouth boldly, to make known the mystery of the gospel, For which I am an ambassador in bonds: that therein I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.

handle: Peace, love and faith from God to the brothers and sisters; grace to all who love Christ.
text: Peace be to the brethren, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ. Grace be with all them that love our Lord Jesus Christ in sincerity. Amen.

handle: You are qualified for the inheritance and rescued from darkness into his Son's kingdom.
text: Giving thanks unto the Father, which hath made us meet to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light: Who hath delivered us from the power of darkness, and hath translated us into the kingdom of his dear Son:

handle: Transferred, redeemed, forgiven.
text: Who hath delivered us from the power of darkness, and hath translated us into the kingdom of his dear Son: In whom we have redemption through his blood, even the forgiveness of sins:

handle: Christ is the image of God, and in him all things hold together.
text: Who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of every creature: For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible, whether they be thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by him, and for him: And he is before all things, and by him all things consist.

handle: Once estranged and hostile in mind; now reconciled, holy and blameless before him.
text: And you, that were sometime alienated and enemies in your mind by wicked works, yet now hath he reconciled In the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and unblameable and unreproveable in his sight:

handle: Christ in you, the hope of glory.
text: To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles; which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:

handle: As you received Christ, walk in him, rooted, built up and overflowing with thanks.
text: As ye have therefore received Christ Jesus the Lord, so walk ye in him: Rooted and built up in him, and stablished in the faith, as ye have been taught, abounding therein with thanksgiving.

handle: Watch that no one takes you captive by empty, deceptive philosophy.
text: Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Christ.

handle: In Christ you have been brought to fullness.
text: For in him dwelleth all the fulness of the Godhead bodily. And ye are complete in him, which is the head of all principality and power:

handle: Made alive with him; the record of debt against you was nailed to the cross.
text: And you, being dead in your sins and the uncircumcision of your flesh, hath he quickened together with him, having forgiven you all trespasses; Blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross;

handle: Seek and set your mind on things above, not on earthly things.
text: If ye then be risen with Christ, seek those things which are above, where Christ sitteth on the right hand of God. Set your affection on things above, not on things on the earth.

handle: You died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.
text: For ye are dead, and your life is hid with Christ in God.

handle: When Christ appears, you appear with him in glory.
text: When Christ, who is our life, shall appear, then shall ye also appear with him in glory.

handle: Put away anger, malice, slander and lying to one another.
text: But now ye also put off all these; anger, wrath, malice, blasphemy, filthy communication out of your mouth. Lie not one to another, seeing that ye have put off the old man with his deeds;

handle: The new self is being renewed in knowledge after its Creator's image.
text: And have put on the new man, which is renewed in knowledge after the image of him that created him:

handle: Christ is all and in all; ethnic and social labels fall away.
text: Where there is neither Greek nor Jew, circumcision nor uncircumcision, Barbarian, Scythian, bond nor free: but Christ is all, and in all.

handle: Chosen, holy and loved: put on compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness, patience.
text: Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering;

handle: Bear with one another and forgive, as the Lord forgave you.
text: Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye.

handle: Above all, put on love, the bond that holds everything together.
text: And above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of perfectness.

handle: Let Christ's peace rule your heart, and be thankful.
text: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.

handle: Let Christ's word dwell in you richly; teach and admonish one another.
text: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.

handle: Whatever you say or do, do it in Jesus' name, giving thanks.
text: And whatsoever ye do in word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him.

handle: Work from the heart as for the Lord; he gives the inheritance.
text: And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men; Knowing that of the Lord ye shall receive the reward of the inheritance: for ye serve the Lord Christ.

handle: Keep praying, alert and thankful.
text: Continue in prayer, and watch in the same with thanksgiving;

handle: Speak with grace, seasoned with salt, knowing how to answer each person.
text: Let your speech be alway with grace, seasoned with salt, that ye may know how ye ought to answer every man.

handle: He who began a good work in you will finish it.
text: Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ:

handle: Love growing in knowledge and discernment.
text: And this I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and in all judgment; That ye may approve things that are excellent; that ye may be sincere and without offence till the day of Christ;

handle: To live is Christ; to die is gain.
text: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

handle: Live worthy of the gospel, standing firm together in one spirit.
text: Only let your conversation be as it becometh the gospel of Christ: that whether I come and see you, or else be absent, I may hear of your affairs, that ye stand fast in one spirit, with one mind striving together for the faith of the gospel;

handle: Because you have encouragement and love in Christ, be of one mind.
text: If there be therefore any consolation in Christ, if any comfort of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any bowels and mercies, Fulfil ye my joy, that ye be likeminded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind.

handle: No selfish ambition or conceit; in humility count others more significant, and look to their interests.
text: Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves. Look not every man on his own things, but every man also on the things of others.

handle: Have the same mind among you that Christ Jesus had.
text: Let this mind be in you, which was also in Christ Jesus:

handle: He did not grasp equality with God; he emptied himself and served.
text: Who, being in the form of God, thought it not robbery to be equal with God: But made himself of no reputation, and took upon him the form of a servant, and was made in the likeness of men: And being found in fashion as a man, he humbled himself, and became obedient unto death, even the death of the cross.

handle: The humbled one is exalted.
text: Wherefore God also hath highly exalted him, and given him a name which is above every name: That at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things in earth, and things under the earth; And that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

handle: Work out your salvation; God is at work in you, giving both the desire and the power.
text: Wherefore, my beloved, as ye have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling. For it is God which worketh in you both to will and to do of his good pleasure.

handle: Do everything without grumbling, and shine as lights.
text: Do all things without murmurings and disputings: That ye may be blameless and harmless, the sons of God, without rebuke, in the midst of a crooked and perverse nation, among whom ye shine as lights in the world;

handle: We boast in Christ and put no confidence in the flesh.
text: For we are the circumcision, which worship God in the spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh.

handle: Everything is loss compared with knowing Christ; righteousness comes through faith, not your own record.
text: Yea doubtless, and I count all things but loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord: for whom I have suffered the loss of all things, and do count them but dung, that I may win Christ, And be found in him, not having mine own righteousness, which is of the law, but that which is through the faith of Christ, the righteousness which is of God by faith:

handle: To know him and the power of his resurrection.
text: That I may know him, and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, being made conformable unto his death;

handle: Forget what is behind; press on toward what is ahead.
text: Brethren, I count not myself to have apprehended: but this one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before, I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.

handle: Your citizenship is in heaven.
text: For our conversation is in heaven; from whence also we look for the Saviour, the Lord Jesus Christ:

handle: Rejoice, and let your gentleness be known to everyone.
text: Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice. Let your moderation be known unto all men. The Lord is at hand.

handle: Do not be anxious; pray with thanksgiving; peace guards your heart and mind.
text: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God. And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.

handle: Think on what is true, honorable, just, pure, lovely, commendable.
text: Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things.

handle: Put into practice what you have learned.
text: Those things, which ye have both learned, and received, and heard, and seen in me, do: and the God of peace shall be with you.

handle: Contentment in every situation, and strength from Christ for it.
text: Not that I speak in respect of want: for I have learned, in whatsoever state I am, therewith to be content. I know both how to be abased, and I know how to abound: every where and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need. I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.

handle: God will supply every need.
text: But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.

handle: You cannot be both a people-pleaser and Christ's servant.
text: For do I now persuade men, or God? or do I seek to please men? for if I yet pleased men, I should not be the servant of Christ.

handle: Crucified with Christ; Christ lives in me; he loved me and gave himself for me.
text: I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me.

handle: All of you are God's children through faith.
text: For ye are all the children of God by faith in Christ Jesus.

handle: You have put on Christ like clothing.
text: For as many of you as have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ.

handle: In Christ the old dividing labels are gone; you are all one.
text: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: for ye are all one in Christ Jesus.

handle: You belong to Christ, so you are Abraham's offspring and heirs.
text: And if ye be Christ’s, then are ye Abraham’s seed, and heirs according to the promise.

handle: God sent his Son so that you might receive adoption.
text: But when the fulness of the time was come, God sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law, To redeem them that were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of sons.

handle: The Spirit cries "Abba"; you are no longer a slave but a child and an heir.
text: And because ye are sons, God hath sent forth the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, Abba, Father. Wherefore thou art no more a servant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.

handle: You know God, or rather, you are known by God.
text: But now, after that ye have known God, or rather are known of God, how turn ye again to the weak and beggarly elements, whereunto ye desire again to be in bondage?

handle: For freedom Christ set you free; do not return to slavery.
text: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.

handle: What counts is faith working through love.
text: For in Jesus Christ neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision; but faith which worketh by love.

handle: Do not use freedom as an excuse for the flesh; serve one another in love.
text: For, brethren, ye have been called unto liberty; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love serve one another.

handle: The whole law is summed up: love your neighbor as yourself.
text: For all the law is fulfilled in one word, even in this; Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

handle: If you bite and devour each other, you will be destroyed by each other.
text: But if ye bite and devour one another, take heed that ye be not consumed one of another.

handle: Walk by the Spirit and you will not gratify the desires of the flesh.
text: This I say then, Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.

handle: The works of the flesh include enmity, strife, jealousy, rage and rivalry.
text: Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are these; Adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness, Idolatry, witchcraft, hatred, variance, emulations, wrath, strife, seditions, heresies, Envyings, murders, drunkenness, revellings, and such like: of the which I tell you before, as I have also told you in time past, that they which do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God.

handle: The Spirit's fruit: love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, self-control.
text: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith, Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.

handle: Those who belong to Christ have crucified the flesh.
text: And they that are Christ’s have crucified the flesh with the affections and lusts.

handle: Keep in step with the Spirit.
text: If we live in the Spirit, let us also walk in the Spirit.

handle: Do not be conceited, provoking or envying one another.
text: Let us not be desirous of vain glory, provoking one another, envying one another.

handle: Restore someone caught in sin gently, and watch yourself.
text: Brethren, if a man be overtaken in a fault, ye which are spiritual, restore such an one in the spirit of meekness; considering thyself, lest thou also be tempted.

handle: Carry one another's burdens, and so fulfill Christ's law.
text: Bear ye one another’s burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.

handle: Do not inflate yourself; test your own work; carry your own load.
text: For if a man think himself to be something, when he is nothing, he deceiveth himself. But let every man prove his own work, and then shall he have rejoicing in himself alone, and not in another. For every man shall bear his own burden.

handle: Do not grow weary of doing good; the harvest comes.
text: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.

handle: Do good to everyone, especially to the household of faith.
text: As we have therefore opportunity, let us do good unto all men, especially unto them who are of the household of faith.

handle: What matters is a new creation.
text: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision, but a new creature.

handle: I am not ashamed of the gospel; it is God's power to save.
text: For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

handle: All fall short; all are justified freely by grace.
text: For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of God; Being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus:

handle: Justified by faith, you have peace with God.
text: Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ:

handle: Hope does not disappoint, because God's love is poured into your heart.
text: And hope maketh not ashamed; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us.

handle: God showed his love: Christ died for us while we were still sinners.
text: But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.

handle: You were raised to walk in newness of life.
text: Therefore we are buried with him by baptism into death: that like as Christ was raised up from the dead by the glory of the Father, even so we also should walk in newness of life.

handle: Count yourself dead to sin and alive to God in Christ.
text: Likewise reckon ye also yourselves to be dead indeed unto sin, but alive unto God through Jesus Christ our Lord.

handle: Sin will not master you; you are under grace.
text: For sin shall not have dominion over you: for ye are not under the law, but under grace.

handle: No condemnation for those in Christ Jesus.
text: There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.

handle: The Spirit's law of life has set you free.
text: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus hath made me free from the law of sin and death.

handle: A mind set on the flesh is death; a mind set on the Spirit is life and peace.
text: For they that are after the flesh do mind the things of the flesh; but they that are after the Spirit the things of the Spirit. For to be carnally minded is death; but to be spiritually minded is life and peace.

handle: The Spirit of God lives in you.
text: But ye are not in the flesh, but in the Spirit, if so be that the Spirit of God dwell in you. Now if any man have not the Spirit of Christ, he is none of his. And if Christ be in you, the body is dead because of sin; but the Spirit is life because of righteousness. But if the Spirit of him that raised up Jesus from the dead dwell in you, he that raised up Christ from the dead shall also quicken your mortal bodies by his Spirit that dwelleth in you.

handle: You received the Spirit of adoption; you are God's child and Christ's co-heir.
text: For ye have not received the spirit of bondage again to fear; but ye have received the Spirit of adoption, whereby we cry, Abba, Father. The Spirit itself beareth witness with our spirit, that we are the children of God: And if children, then heirs; heirs of God, and joint-heirs with Christ; if so be that we suffer with him, that we may be also glorified together.

handle: The Spirit helps your weakness and prays for you.
text: Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered.

handle: God works all things together for the good of those who love him.
text: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.

handle: You are being shaped into the likeness of his Son.
text: For whom he did foreknow, he also did predestinate to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brethren.

handle: If God is for us, who can be against us?
text: What shall we then say to these things? If God be for us, who can be against us?

handle: Who can condemn? Christ intercedes for you.
text: Who shall lay any thing to the charge of God’s elect? It is God that justifieth. Who is he that condemneth? It is Christ that died, yea rather, that is risen again, who is even at the right hand of God, who also maketh intercession for us.

handle: Nothing in all creation can separate you from God's love in Christ.
text: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? shall tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword? As it is written, For thy sake we are killed all the day long; we are accounted as sheep for the slaughter. Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us. For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come, Nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

handle: Offer yourself to God as a living sacrifice.
text: I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God, which is your reasonable service.

handle: Do not be shaped by this age; be transformed by the renewing of your mind, and you will test and approve God's will.
text: And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.

handle: Think of yourself with sober judgment, not inflated.
text: For I say, through the grace given unto me, to every man that is among you, not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think; but to think soberly, according as God hath dealt to every man the measure of faith.

handle: Many members, one body, each belonging to all the others.
text: For as we have many members in one body, and all members have not the same office: So we, being many, are one body in Christ, and every one members one of another.

handle: Gifts differ; use yours.
text: Having then gifts differing according to the grace that is given to us, whether prophecy, let us prophesy according to the proportion of faith; Or ministry, let us wait on our ministering: or he that teacheth, on teaching; Or he that exhorteth, on exhortation: he that giveth, let him do it with simplicity; he that ruleth, with diligence; he that sheweth mercy, with cheerfulness.

handle: Love must be sincere; hate what is evil, cling to what is good.
text: Let love be without dissimulation. Abhor that which is evil; cleave to that which is good.

handle: Be devoted to one another; outdo each other in showing honor.
text: Be kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love; in honour preferring one another;

handle: Joyful in hope, patient in trouble, faithful in prayer, generous and hospitable.
text: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer; Distributing to the necessity of saints; given to hospitality.

handle: Bless those who persecute you.
text: Bless them which persecute you: bless, and curse not.

handle: Rejoice with those who rejoice; weep with those who weep.
text: Rejoice with them that do rejoice, and weep with them that weep.

handle: Live in harmony; be humble; do not think yourself wise.
text: Be of the same mind one toward another. Mind not high things, but condescend to men of low estate. Be not wise in your own conceits.

handle: Do not repay evil for evil; as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
text: Recompense to no man evil for evil. Provide things honest in the sight of all men. If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men.

handle: Do not be overcome by evil; overcome evil with good.
text: Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.

handle: Owe no one anything except love; love does no harm to a neighbor.
text: Owe no man any thing, but to love one another: for he that loveth another hath fulfilled the law. For this, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not kill, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness, Thou shalt not covet; and if there be any other commandment, it is briefly comprehended in this saying, namely, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself. Love worketh no ill to his neighbour: therefore love is the fulfilling of the law.

handle: Welcome those who are weak in faith; do not quarrel over opinions.
text: Him that is weak in the faith receive ye, but not to doubtful disputations.

handle: Do not judge your brother or sister; each will give an account to God.
text: But why dost thou judge thy brother? or why dost thou set at nought thy brother? for we shall all stand before the judgment seat of Christ. For it is written, As I live, saith the Lord, every knee shall bow to me, and every tongue shall confess to God. So then every one of us shall give account of himself to God. Let us not therefore judge one another any more: but judge this rather, that no man put a stumblingblock or an occasion to fall in his brother’s way.

handle: Pursue what makes for peace and mutual building up.
text: Let us therefore follow after the things which make for peace, and things wherewith one may edify another.

handle: The strong bear with the weak and please their neighbor to build them up.
text: We then that are strong ought to bear the infirmities of the weak, and not to please ourselves. Let every one of us please his neighbour for his good to edification.

handle: Welcome one another as Christ welcomed you, for God's glory.
text: Wherefore receive ye one another, as Christ also received us to the glory of God.

handle: May the God of hope fill you with joy and peace.
text: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.

handle: God chose the weak and lowly so that no one can boast before him.
text: For ye see your calling, brethren, how that not many wise men after the flesh, not many mighty, not many noble, are called: But God hath chosen the foolish things of the world to confound the wise; and God hath chosen the weak things of the world to confound the things which are mighty; And base things of the world, and things which are despised, hath God chosen, yea, and things which are not, to bring to nought things that are: That no flesh should glory in his presence.

handle: You are in Christ, who is your wisdom, righteousness and redemption; boast only in the Lord.
text: But of him are ye in Christ Jesus, who of God is made unto us wisdom, and righteousness, and sanctification, and redemption: That, according as it is written, He that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord.

handle: You have the mind of Christ.
text: For who hath known the mind of the Lord, that he may instruct him? But we have the mind of Christ.

handle: You are God's temple, and his Spirit lives among you.
text: Know ye not that ye are the temple of God, and that the Spirit of God dwelleth in you?

handle: Do not boast in people; everything is yours, and you are Christ's.
text: Therefore let no man glory in men. For all things are yours; Whether Paul, or Apollos, or Cephas, or the world, or life, or death, or things present, or things to come; all are yours; And ye are Christ’s; and Christ is God’s.

handle: What do you have that you did not receive? Why boast?
text: For who maketh thee to differ from another? and what hast thou that thou didst not receive? now if thou didst receive it, why dost thou glory, as if thou hadst not received it?

handle: That is what some of you were; but you were washed, made holy, justified.
text: And such were some of you: but ye are washed, but ye are sanctified, but ye are justified in the name of the Lord Jesus, and by the Spirit of our God.

handle: Your body is the Spirit's temple; you are not your own, you were bought.
text: What? know ye not that your body is the temple of the Holy Ghost which is in you, which ye have of God, and ye are not your own? For ye are bought with a price: therefore glorify God in your body, and in your spirit, which are God’s.

handle: Every temptation is common; God is faithful and provides a way out.
text: There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it.

handle: Seek the good of your neighbor, not just your own.
text: Let no man seek his own, but every man another’s wealth.

handle: Whatever you do, do it for God's glory.
text: Whether therefore ye eat, or drink, or whatsoever ye do, do all to the glory of God.

handle: One body, many parts, all baptized into it by one Spirit.
text: For as the body is one, and hath many members, and all the members of that one body, being many, are one body: so also is Christ. For by one Spirit are we all baptized into one body, whether we be Jews or Gentiles, whether we be bond or free; and have been all made to drink into one Spirit.

handle: No part can say to another, "I do not need you."
text: And the eye cannot say unto the hand, I have no need of thee: nor again the head to the feet, I have no need of you. Nay, much more those members of the body, which seem to be more feeble, are necessary: And those members of the body, which we think to be less honourable, upon these we bestow more abundant honour; and our uncomely parts have more abundant comeliness. For our comely parts have no need: but God hath tempered the body together, having given more abundant honour to that part which lacked: That there should be no schism in the body; but that the members should have the same care one for another.

handle: If one member suffers, all suffer; if one is honored, all rejoice.
text: And whether one member suffer, all the members suffer with it; or one member be honoured, all the members rejoice with it.

handle: Without love, even great gifts and sacrifices are nothing.
text: Though I speak with the tongues of men and of angels, and have not charity, I am become as sounding brass, or a tinkling cymbal. And though I have the gift of prophecy, and understand all mysteries, and all knowledge; and though I have all faith, so that I could remove mountains, and have not charity, I am nothing. And though I bestow all my goods to feed the poor, and though I give my body to be burned, and have not charity, it profiteth me nothing.

handle: Love is patient and kind, keeps no record of wrongs, bears and believes and hopes all things.
text: Charity suffereth long, and is kind; charity envieth not; charity vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up, Doth not behave itself unseemly, seeketh not her own, is not easily provoked, thinketh no evil; Rejoiceth not in iniquity, but rejoiceth in the truth; Beareth all things, believeth all things, hopeth all things, endureth all things.

handle: Now we know in part; faith, hope and love remain, and love is greatest.
text: For now we see through a glass, darkly; but then face to face: now I know in part; but then shall I know even as also I am known. And now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.

handle: By God's grace I am what I am.
text: But by the grace of God I am what I am: and his grace which was bestowed upon me was not in vain; but I laboured more abundantly than they all: yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.

handle: Bad company corrupts good character.
text: Be not deceived: evil communications corrupt good manners.

handle: Stand firm; your labor in the Lord is not in vain.
text: Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.

handle: Be alert and stand firm; do everything in love.
text: Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong. Let all your things be done with charity.

handle: God comforts you in trouble so you can comfort others with the same comfort.
text: Blessed be God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort; Who comforteth us in all our tribulation, that we may be able to comfort them which are in any trouble, by the comfort wherewith we ourselves are comforted of God.

handle: Every promise is "yes" in Christ; he anointed, sealed and gave you the Spirit.
text: For all the promises of God in him are yea, and in him Amen, unto the glory of God by us. Now he which stablisheth us with you in Christ, and hath anointed us, is God; Who hath also sealed us, and given the earnest of the Spirit in our hearts.

handle: Do not be outwitted by Satan; we know his designs.
text: Lest Satan should get an advantage of us: for we are not ignorant of his devices.

handle: Where the Spirit is, there is freedom; you are being transformed from glory to glory.
text: Now the Lord is that Spirit: and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty. But we all, with open face beholding as in a glass the glory of the Lord, are changed into the same image from glory to glory, even as by the Spirit of the Lord.

handle: The light of God's glory in your heart; the treasure is in clay jars, so the power is his.
text: For God, who commanded the light to shine out of darkness, hath shined in our hearts, to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ. But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the excellency of the power may be of God, and not of us.

handle: Pressed but not crushed, struck down but not destroyed.
text: We are troubled on every side, yet not distressed; we are perplexed, but not in despair; Persecuted, but not forsaken; cast down, but not destroyed;

handle: Outwardly wasting, inwardly renewed day by day; look at what is unseen.
text: For which cause we faint not; but though our outward man perish, yet the inward man is renewed day by day. For our light affliction, which is but for a moment, worketh for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory; While we look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen: for the things which are seen are temporal; but the things which are not seen are eternal.

handle: Walk by faith, not by sight.
text: (For we walk by faith, not by sight:)

handle: The love of Christ compels us to live for him.
text: For the love of Christ constraineth us; because we thus judge, that if one died for all, then were all dead: And that he died for all, that they which live should not henceforth live unto themselves, but unto him which died for them, and rose again.

handle: If anyone is in Christ, the new creation has come.
text: Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.

handle: You have been given the ministry of reconciliation; you are Christ's ambassador.
text: And all things are of God, who hath reconciled us to himself by Jesus Christ, and hath given to us the ministry of reconciliation; To wit, that God was in Christ, reconciling the world unto himself, not imputing their trespasses unto them; and hath committed unto us the word of reconciliation. Now then we are ambassadors for Christ, as though God did beseech you by us: we pray you in Christ’s stead, be ye reconciled to God.

handle: Christ became sin for us so we could become God's righteousness in him.
text: For he hath made him to be sin for us, who knew no sin; that we might be made the righteousness of God in him.

handle: Do not receive God's grace in vain.
text: We then, as workers together with him, beseech you also that ye receive not the grace of God in vain.

handle: Godly sorrow leads to repentance without regret.
text: For godly sorrow worketh repentance to salvation not to be repented of: but the sorrow of the world worketh death.

handle: Give as you have decided, not reluctantly; God loves a cheerful giver.
text: Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver.

handle: Take every thought captive to obey Christ.
text: For though we walk in the flesh, we do not war after the flesh: (For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds;) Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ;

handle: Do not compare yourselves with others; it is not wise.
text: For we dare not make ourselves of the number, or compare ourselves with some that commend themselves: but they measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves among themselves, are not wise.

handle: Boast in the Lord; what matters is his commendation, not self-commendation.
text: But he that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord. For not he that commendeth himself is approved, but whom the Lord commendeth.

handle: Guard against minds led astray from sincere devotion to Christ.
text: But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty, so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.

handle: My grace is enough for you; power is made perfect in weakness.
text: And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me. Therefore I take pleasure in infirmities, in reproaches, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses for Christ’s sake: for when I am weak, then am I strong.

handle: Aim for restoration, encourage one another, live in peace; the God of love will be with you.
text: Finally, brethren, farewell. Be perfect, be of good comfort, be of one mind, live in peace; and the God of love and peace shall be with you.

handle: You are loved by God and chosen.
text: Knowing, brethren beloved, your election of God.

handle: We speak to please God, who tests our hearts, not people.
text: But as we were allowed of God to be put in trust with the gospel, even so we speak; not as pleasing men, but God, which trieth our hearts.

handle: Be gentle as a nursing mother, sharing not just the gospel but your own life.
text: But we were gentle among you, even as a nurse cherisheth her children: So being affectionately desirous of you, we were willing to have imparted unto you, not the gospel of God only, but also our own souls, because ye were dear unto us.

handle: May the Lord make your love for one another and for all overflow.
text: And the Lord make you to increase and abound in love one toward another, and toward all men, even as we do toward you:

handle: This is God's will: your sanctification.
text: For this is the will of God, even your sanctification, that ye should abstain from fornication:

handle: God has taught you to love one another; do it more and more.
text: But as touching brotherly love ye need not that I write unto you: for ye yourselves are taught of God to love one another. And indeed ye do it toward all the brethren which are in all Macedonia: but we beseech you, brethren, that ye increase more and more;

handle: Live quietly, mind your own affairs, work with your hands.
text: And that ye study to be quiet, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, as we commanded you; That ye may walk honestly toward them that are without, and that ye may have lack of nothing.

handle: Encourage one another and build each other up.
text: Wherefore comfort yourselves together, and edify one another, even as also ye do.

handle: Respect those who labor among you, and live at peace.
text: And we beseech you, brethren, to know them which labour among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you; And to esteem them very highly in love for their work’s sake. And be at peace among yourselves.

handle: Warn the idle, encourage the timid, help the weak, be patient with everyone.
text: Now we exhort you, brethren, warn them that are unruly, comfort the feebleminded, support the weak, be patient toward all men.

handle: Never pay back wrong for wrong; always pursue what is good.
text: See that none render evil for evil unto any man; but ever follow that which is good, both among yourselves, and to all men.

handle: Rejoice always, pray constantly, thank God in every circumstance; this is his will for you.
text: Rejoice evermore. Pray without ceasing. In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.

handle: Do not quench the Spirit; test everything and keep what is good.
text: Quench not the Spirit. Despise not prophesyings. Prove all things; hold fast that which is good.

handle: The God of peace will sanctify you; the one who calls you is faithful and will do it.
text: And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly; and I pray God your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ. Faithful is he that calleth you, who also will do it.

handle: The Lord is faithful; he will strengthen you and guard you from the evil one.
text: But the Lord is faithful, who shall stablish you, and keep you from evil.

handle: Do not tire of doing what is right.
text: But ye, brethren, be not weary in well doing.

handle: The goal of instruction is love from a pure heart, a good conscience and sincere faith.
text: Now the end of the commandment is charity out of a pure heart, and of a good conscience, and of faith unfeigned:

handle: Christ came to save sinners; Paul's mercy is a pattern for others.
text: This is a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief. Howbeit for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first Jesus Christ might shew forth all longsuffering, for a pattern to them which should hereafter believe on him to life everlasting.

handle: Pray for everyone; God wants all to be saved.
text: I exhort therefore, that, first of all, supplications, prayers, intercessions, and giving of thanks, be made for all men; For kings, and for all that are in authority; that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and honesty. For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Saviour; Who will have all men to be saved, and to come unto the knowledge of the truth.

handle: Do not let anyone look down on you; set the example.
text: Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.

handle: Treat older men as fathers, younger men as brothers, older women as mothers, younger women as sisters, in purity.
text: Rebuke not an elder, but intreat him as a father; and the younger men as brethren; The elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, with all purity.

handle: Godliness with contentment is great gain.
text: But godliness with contentment is great gain.

handle: Pursue righteousness, faith, love and gentleness; fight the good fight.
text: But thou, O man of God, flee these things; and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, meekness. Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, whereunto thou art also called, and hast professed a good profession before many witnesses.

handle: God gave you a spirit of power, love and self-control, not fear.
text: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.

handle: Saved and called by his own purpose and grace, not by your works.
text: Who hath saved us, and called us with an holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given us in Christ Jesus before the world began,

handle: Present yourself approved, handling the word of truth rightly.
text: Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.

handle: The Lord's servant must be kind, patient and gentle, not quarrelsome.
text: And the servant of the Lord must not strive; but be gentle unto all men, apt to teach, patient, In meekness instructing those that oppose themselves; if God peradventure will give them repentance to the acknowledging of the truth;

handle: All Scripture is God-breathed, to teach, correct and equip you for every good work.
text: All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness: That the man of God may be perfect, throughly furnished unto all good works.

handle: The Lord stood by me and strengthened me.
text: Notwithstanding the Lord stood with me, and strengthened me; that by me the preaching might be fully known, and that all the Gentiles might hear: and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.

handle: Grace trains us to say no to ungodliness.
text: For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men, Teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world;

handle: Slander no one, be gentle, show courtesy to everyone.
text: To speak evil of no man, to be no brawlers, but gentle, shewing all meekness unto all men.

handle: We were foolish and enslaved too; he saved us by his mercy, not our deeds.
text: For we ourselves also were sometimes foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving divers lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another. But after that the kindness and love of God our Saviour toward man appeared, Not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to his mercy he saved us, by the washing of regeneration, and renewing of the Holy Ghost;

handle: Receive a former slave as a beloved brother, as you would receive Paul.
text: For perhaps he therefore departed for a season, that thou shouldest receive him for ever; Not now as a servant, but above a servant, a brother beloved, specially to me, but how much more unto thee, both in the flesh, and in the Lord? If thou count me therefore a partner, receive him as myself.

handle: The Father names Jesus beloved, with whom he is pleased, before any ministry begins.
text: And Jesus, when he was baptized, went up straightway out of the water: and, lo, the heavens were opened unto him, and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove, and lighting upon him: And lo a voice from heaven, saying, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.

handle: People live on every word that comes from God's mouth.
text: But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.

handle: The Beatitudes: blessing for the poor in spirit, the meek, the merciful, the peacemakers.
text: Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven. Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted. Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth. Blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled. Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy. Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God. Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God. Blessed are they which are persecuted for righteousness’ sake: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven. Blessed are ye, when men shall revile you, and persecute you, and shall say all manner of evil against you falsely, for my sake. Rejoice, and be exceeding glad: for great is your reward in heaven: for so persecuted they the prophets which were before you.

handle: You are the light of the world; let it be seen.
text: Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid. Neither do men light a candle, and put it under a bushel, but on a candlestick; and it giveth light unto all that are in the house. Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.

handle: If someone has something against you, go and be reconciled first.
text: Therefore if thou bring thy gift to the altar, and there rememberest that thy brother hath ought against thee; Leave there thy gift before the altar, and go thy way; first be reconciled to thy brother, and then come and offer thy gift.

handle: Love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you.
text: Ye have heard that it hath been said, Thou shalt love thy neighbour, and hate thine enemy. But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you; That ye may be the children of your Father which is in heaven: for he maketh his sun to rise on the evil and on the good, and sendeth rain on the just and on the unjust.

handle: "Our Father... your will be done." Pray to a Father, and for his will.
text: After this manner therefore pray ye: Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven.

handle: Forgive others, and your Father forgives you.
text: For if ye forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you: But if ye forgive not men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.

handle: Where your treasure is, your heart will be too.
text: Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon earth, where moth and rust doth corrupt, and where thieves break through and steal: But lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust doth corrupt, and where thieves do not break through nor steal: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

handle: Do not worry about life; you are worth more than the birds.
text: Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink; nor yet for your body, what ye shall put on. Is not the life more than meat, and the body than raiment? Behold the fowls of the air: for they sow not, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns; yet your heavenly Father feedeth them. Are ye not much better than they? Which of you by taking thought can add one cubit unto his stature?

handle: Seek first his kingdom and righteousness.
text: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.

handle: Take the plank out of your own eye before the speck in your brother's.
text: Judge not, that ye be not judged. For with what judgment ye judge, ye shall be judged: and with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you again. And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother’s eye, but considerest not the beam that is in thine own eye? Or how wilt thou say to thy brother, Let me pull out the mote out of thine eye; and, behold, a beam is in thine own eye? Thou hypocrite, first cast out the beam out of thine own eye; and then shalt thou see clearly to cast out the mote out of thy brother’s eye.

handle: Treat others as you want to be treated.
text: Therefore all things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you, do ye even so to them: for this is the law and the prophets.

handle: Not a sparrow falls without the Father; you are worth more than many sparrows.
text: Are not two sparrows sold for a farthing? and one of them shall not fall on the ground without your Father. But the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Fear ye not therefore, ye are of more value than many sparrows.

handle: Come to me, weary ones; I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest.
text: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls. For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.

handle: What comes out of the mouth comes from the heart; there is where the defiling starts.
text: But those things which proceed out of the mouth come forth from the heart; and they defile the man. For out of the heart proceed evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, fornications, thefts, false witness, blasphemies:

handle: Become like a child: the greatest is the humble.
text: At the same time came the disciples unto Jesus, saying, Who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven? And Jesus called a little child unto him, and set him in the midst of them, And said, Verily I say unto you, Except ye be converted, and become as little children, ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven. Whosoever therefore shall humble himself as this little child, the same is greatest in the kingdom of heaven.

handle: If your brother sins against you, go and speak to him privately.
text: Moreover if thy brother shall trespass against thee, go and tell him his fault between thee and him alone: if he shall hear thee, thou hast gained thy brother.

handle: Forgive without keeping count.
text: Then came Peter to him, and said, Lord, how oft shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? till seven times? Jesus saith unto him, I say not unto thee, Until seven times: but, Until seventy times seven.

handle: Should you not have mercy, as I had mercy on you?
text: Then his lord, after that he had called him, said unto him, O thou wicked servant, I forgave thee all that debt, because thou desiredst me: Shouldest not thou also have had compassion on thy fellowservant, even as I had pity on thee?

handle: Among you, the great one serves; Christ himself came to give his life.
text: But it shall not be so among you: but whosoever will be great among you, let him be your minister; And whosoever will be chief among you, let him be your servant: Even as the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.

handle: Love God with all you are, and your neighbor as yourself; all the law hangs on these.
text: Jesus said unto him, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind. This is the first and great commandment. And the second is like unto it, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself. On these two commandments hang all the law and the prophets.

handle: The greatest is your servant; those who humble themselves will be lifted up.
text: But he that is greatest among you shall be your servant. And whosoever shall exalt himself shall be abased; and he that shall humble himself shall be exalted.

handle: What you did for the least of these, you did for me.
text: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me drink: I was a stranger, and ye took me in: Naked, and ye clothed me: I was sick, and ye visited me: I was in prison, and ye came unto me. Then shall the righteous answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, and fed thee? or thirsty, and gave thee drink? When saw we thee a stranger, and took thee in? or naked, and clothed thee? Or when saw we thee sick, or in prison, and came unto thee? And the King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren, ye have done it unto me.

handle: I am with you always, to the end of the age.
text: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you alway, even unto the end of the world. Amen.

handle: Whoever wants to be first must be last and servant of all.
text: And he sat down, and called the twelve, and saith unto them, If any man desire to be first, the same shall be last of all, and servant of all.

handle: The Son of Man came not to be served but to serve and give his life.
text: For even the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.

handle: When you pray, forgive anyone you hold something against.
text: And when ye stand praying, forgive, if ye have ought against any: that your Father also which is in heaven may forgive you your trespasses.

handle: Be merciful, as your Father is merciful.
text: But love ye your enemies, and do good, and lend, hoping for nothing again; and your reward shall be great, and ye shall be the children of the Highest: for he is kind unto the unthankful and to the evil. Be ye therefore merciful, as your Father also is merciful.

handle: Do not judge or condemn; forgive; the measure you give is the measure you get.
text: Judge not, and ye shall not be judged: condemn not, and ye shall not be condemned: forgive, and ye shall be forgiven: Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again.

handle: The mouth speaks from the heart's overflow.
text: A good man out of the good treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is good; and an evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is evil: for of the abundance of the heart his mouth speaketh.

handle: The neighbor is the one who showed mercy; go and do likewise.
text: Which now of these three, thinkest thou, was neighbour unto him that fell among the thieves? And he said, He that shewed mercy on him. Then said Jesus unto him, Go, and do thou likewise.

handle: Not one sparrow is forgotten; you are worth more than many.
text: Are not five sparrows sold for two farthings, and not one of them is forgotten before God? But even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Fear not therefore: ye are of more value than many sparrows.

handle: Guard against every kind of greed.
text: And he said unto them, Take heed, and beware of covetousness: for a man’s life consisteth not in the abundance of the things which he possesseth.

handle: The father runs, embraces and restores the returning son.
text: And he arose, and came to his father. But when he was yet a great way off, his father saw him, and had compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him. And the son said unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in thy sight, and am no more worthy to be called thy son.
